sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "hero_power"."hero_id" AS e, "alignment"."alignment" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "hero_power" JOIN "superhero" ON "superhero"."id" = "hero_power"."hero_id" JOIN "alignment" ON "alignment"."id" = "superhero"."alignment_id" GROUP BY "hero_power"."hero_id", "alignment"."alignment"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the g total of number of hero_power records (g level)
rank within the group by number of hero_power records, keep the top 3
